scripts.build: npm run build -w @data-collector/shared && npm run build -w @data-collector/bridge && npm run build -w @data-collector/extension
scripts.setup: npm run build && node packages/bridge/dist/cli.js bridge install
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/bridge --pretty false && tsc -p packages/extension/tsconfig.json --pretty false
